description: Pins a report for the person (pinned: true) so it stays at the top of their Reports page in CodeGene, or takes their pin off (pinned: false). A pin is the person's own: nobody else sees it and it changes no one's access. Refused when they already hold the most pins they may.

pinned.description: true to pin, false to unpin.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: pin_report
title: Pin or unpin a report
